muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is a full legal-move search with maximal-play filtering and a positional evaluation. All entry, blocking, hitting and strict bear-off rules are simulated to generate every sequentially legal order. The global backgammon rule is then enforced: play two checkers if possible, otherwise play the higher die. Each resulting afterstate is scored by pip difference, off and bar tempo, made-point and prime structure, stacking waste, and blot exposure counting direct 1-6 shots and indirect 7-12 shots in both directions with home, anchor and middle bonuses. The highest scoring legal sequence is returned.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is a 1-ply legal-move search with a contact-vs-race evaluation. All sequentially legal `H/L:FROM1,FROM2` actions are generated by exact simulation of bar-first, block, hit and bear-off rules, pass is allowed only if no move exists for that die, then the global must-use-both / must-use-higher rule is applied. Remaining moves are scored by off, bar, pip, blots, exposure to direct 1-6 hits, made points, longest prime, home-board control, anchors, 5/4/bar-point bonuses and stack waste, with separate race weights when boards are separated, picking the maximum.
muse_spark_1.3/003: Strategy is exhaustive 1-ply search with strong heuristic: enumerate all action strings that satisfy bar-priority, block, bear-off, max-dice and higher-die rules for both H/L orders, then score resulting boards by pip race, borne-off, bar, made points, home-board, anchor/key points, stacking, prime and blot exposure with direct hit probability, picking the best. A safe fallback guarantees a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/004: Strong backgammon requires correct legality, pip-race, hitting, making points, primes, anchors and safety from shots, plus shallow opponent lookahead. The policy enumerates all stepwise-legal H/L sequences with correct bar, block and bear-off rules, enforces must-play-both / must-play-higher, then picks by static evaluation refined with expected opponent reply.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is 1-ply exhaustive search with correct Backgammon move legality. All move orders are simulated with bar priority, blocks, hits and strict bear-off, then filtered by must-play-both and must-play-high rules. Remaining legal actions are scored by race, bar/off, blot exposure only when actually hittable, made points, home board, prime, anchor, stacks and containment when opponent is on the bar. The best scoring action is returned, guaranteeing a legal H/L:FROM1,FROM2 string.
